content: Yɛsu kan'kɔɔr aŋadweelà an'be
Ungö apan ba bàkɔlà u sim lumwɛy là ɛwà, u nsi a Bàngɛlàsà.
Pa kàtoo Yɛsu u bwaar, baal mwɛy wàŋàyɔl a an'dweelà an'be kàyàtoo kà an'dii, waa kàyàbwey anà nde.
Nde kàfabwaayà kà an'dii. Akà mbuur mwɛy kàfàkwo anki mukun'bäm itàkal dwaaŋ.
Ntɔn mbalà mbɔɔn ba bàfun'bäämà iswɛɛy anà dwaaŋ, wɛɛ nde kàtsüülà mya. Akà mbuur mwɛy kàkwe anki mukun'kyäämà.
Taaŋ lanswà, mpib anà mwäänà, nde kàkäl muyità nsay uboo a an'dii anà u myɔŋ, wàmuyikuub in'kwɛŋ anà muyikàkaam ndür a in'kul.
Umpal kàmɛn nde Yɛsu ukwɛl, nde kàkyen ntiin, waa kàbü an'köm kusà a nde,
waa kàkuub in'kwɛŋ anà mutɛn naa: « Ininà akà mɛ anà ngye, Yɛsu, Mwan a Nzam a Dudu? Mɛ amabɔɔn kà ikɔb a Nzam, twon aman'pà mpay! »
Ntɔn Yɛsu kàtɛɛnà a nde naa: « Dweelà a làbe, too unsà mbuur wà! »
Nde kun'fuul naa: « Ikɔb angye nà? » Nde kun'fuur naa: « Ikɔb a mɛ "Un'kàbɔ", ntɔn bi ibà mbɔɔn. »
Nde waa kun'bɔ̈ɔ̈nà mbɔɔn, ntɔn nde ukɔɔn akaböŋ u nsi ayin.
Kyekà, mper akà mɔŋ, làkäl anà làböl a kölàköl là ngul làkäl muyidyà.
An'dweelà an'be màbɔ̈ɔ̈n Yɛsu naa: « Itöm uboo a ngul ntɔn bi ibilà amu ya! »
Yɛsu kapɛ mbwo. Apan laa màtoo ma, màbilà ma uboo a ngul, làböl, fà iköl a mɔŋ, làkàbwà kà ɛwà. Ya yàkäl isii a nsaab yweel, waa làminà.
Aseey a ngul batiin ba, ba bàkàpay làsaŋ uboo a bul anà kà itsuŋ a ndwà. Apan baar waa bàyi muman ndaa yàlyaaŋ.
Mpal bàyàtol ba tsütsü apà Yɛsu anà bàmɛn ba aŋadweelà an'be akyàbwaay, akyàbwaar anà akyàkal a duu, nde mbuur kàkäl anà Un'kàbɔ, ba bàmɛn bɔɔmà.
Baar bàmɛn ya yanswà yàlyaŋ, ba bakyäänà ndaa yàbweel mbuur aŋadweelà an'be anà ngul.
Apan ba bàsɛmà mukun'bɔɔn naa nde ulwomà kà itiir a nsi aba.
Umpal kàkäl Yɛsu mubilà u bwaar, mbuur awà kàkäl anà an'dweelà an'be kun'lɔ̈ɔ̈m naa
Yɛsu kun'pɛ anki mbwo, wɛɛ nde kàtɛn a nde naa: « Furà ndwà a ngye, ntsü akà atoŋ angye, waa akakyään ndaa yanswà kàmakyer Mwol unsà ngyɛb ande. »
Apan, baal awà kàkyen nde, nde kàsɛmà mukyään indiir a kölàköl byanswà kàkyer Yɛsu akà nde u Dɛkapɔl. Baar banswà bakyer abemà.
Mwan a Zayirɔs wà un'kaar anà un'kaar kàbä ipfɛy a Yɛsu
Mpal kàfurà Yɛsu sim lumwɛy u bwaar, un'sɛŋ a baar mbɔɔn kàyàkɔ̈ŋ apà nde. Nde kàkäl kà un'kɔɔl a ɛwà.
Apan umwɛy uboo a amfum a ndwà a nköŋ a Ayudà, ikɔb ande Zayirɔs, umpal kàmɛn nde Yɛsu, nde kàbü kà in'kɔl ande,
waa kun'bɔ̈ɔ̈n mbɔɔn, mutɛn naa: « Mwan un'kye amɛ wà un'kaar wà tsütsü mukwà, yun'si an'kɔɔ ntɔn nde ukɔɔrà, uwü mɔ̈ɔ̈! »
Yɛsu kàkyen mbwo mwɛy anà nde. Un'sɛŋ a baar mbɔɔn kàyun'labà, waa kàyun'bàbääbà.
Kyekà kàkäl anà un'kaar mwɛy kàyitoo an'kil mbul kwem aŋiyweel.
Nde kàmɛn mpay mbɔɔn muyikyà akà ingaŋ mbɔɔn, kàmay indiir ande byanswà, ukɔɔn aman ubwaŋ. Wɛɛ ukyal ande bàkyer afàsöönà mbɔɔn.
Umpal kàwem un'kaar awà ndaa bàtɛɛnà baar ntɔn Yɛsu, nde kàkül ungö, uboo a un'sɛŋ a baar, waa kàbä ipfɛy ande.
Ntɔn nde kàtɛɛnà nde ŋàkwo naa: « Isàkal naa mɛ in'tàba akà ipfɛy ande mpɛl, mɛ in'kyɛr awà mɔ̈ɔ̈. »
Taaŋ nsil alan sye an'kil ande waa màtsü mutoo, nde kàyöb u ndür ande naa nde kan'kɔɔrà unsà ukyal ande.
Apan sye, Yɛsu waa kàyöb naa ngwal mwɛy yan'too u ndür ande, nde kàbulà uboboo a un'sɛŋ a baar, waa kàfuulà naa: « Nà kan'ba ipfɛy amɛ? »
Alɔŋki ande bàtɛɛnà a nde naa: « Ngye akimanà naa un'sɛŋ a baar wàmukabàbääbà, wɛɛ ngye afuulà naa: "Nà kàman'ba?" »
Wɛɛ nde kàleerà umbil ande ntɔn muyöb naa un'kaar nà kan'kyer abà.
Apan, abà kàyöb un'kaar awun ndaa yun'yeel, unsà bɔɔmà anà matɛɛr, nde kàyàbwà kà in'kɔl a Yɛsu, waa kàtɛn a nde ndandaa yanswà.
Yɛsu kàtɛn a nde naa: « Mangwa, làkwikilà angye làmatswà mɔ̈ɔ̈. Kyen a duu, wɛy naa ngye akɔɔrà unsà ukyal angye. »
Nde kàkäl aŋàtàmay anki muyääm, umpal bàyi baar bàfü ndwà a mfum a ndwà a nköŋ a Ayudà, waa bàtɛn naa: « Mwan angye wà un'kaar kan'kwà. Ntɔn nkye mufàtwääl Un'lɔɔŋ nkwom? »
Wɛɛ Yɛsu kàsàlab anki ndaa ayi, waa kàtɛn a mfum a ndwà a nköŋ a Ayudà naa: « Twon an'man bɔɔmà, sà làkwikilà mpɛl. »
Abun, nde kàpɛ anki mbwo akà mbuur mukun'swà, nà Petɔlà, Zyak, anà un'tɔŋ ande Ywan mpɛl.
Ba ban'kɔlà u ndwà a mfum a ndwà a nköŋ a Ayudà. Yɛsu kan'man baar ban'kal udu udu, bàmulel, bàmusà in'kwɛŋ mbɔɔn.
Nde kan'bilà, waa kan'tɛn a ba naa: « Ntɔn nkye minii ami anà ilel abi? Mwan kà wàŋàkwà anki, nde wàŋàbɔ̈ɔ̈n. »
Ba bàkyer un'sɛɛ. Wɛɛ nde kàtwey baar banswà, waa kàwɛl nà taarande anà ngwän a mwan anà baar bàyun'swà. Apan nde kan'bilà u suk kàkäl mwan.
Nde kan'tà kɔɔ a mwan mpi, waa kan'tɛn a nde naa: « Mwan un'kaar, mɛ amaswaŋ, wiyà! »
Apan sye, mwan un'kaar waa kàmbarà, waa kàsemà mukyà, - nde kàkäl ayà mbul kwem aŋiyweel. Apan, ba bàkäl unsà ubem mbɔɔn.
Yɛsu kaswɛŋ a ngwal naa akà mbuur mwɛy ukɔɔn ayöb, waa kàtɛn naa ba bun'pɛ isaa adyà.
